posts.body: If you show it with an event look at your "show picture" command and check the blend mode, it must be "normal"

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
spades141 said:
without having to put a yes or no choice?
Click to expand...
an invisible show text - backgreound transparent, no text in the window and nothing will be visible but the engine will still wait for the show text confirmation. erase after
your command has no number for the picture, please change that
EDIT:
and remove the space from the filename of the picture, that will otherwise cause problems with some deployment options.
